lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹਦੇ ਖੁਹਦੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਹਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: rahade khuhade ni(n)dak maarian kar aape aahar ||
lines.translation: By their own efforts, the slanderers have destroyed all remnants of themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਜਾਹਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee naanakaa varatai sabh jaahar ||1||
lines.translation: The Support of the Saints, O Nanak, is manifest, pervading everywhere. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਮੁੰਢ ਤੇ ਕਿਥੈ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਹਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dhahu bhule mu(n)dh te kithai paain hath ||
lines.translation: Those who went astray from the Primal Being in the very beginning - where can they find refuge?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ti(n)nai maare naanakaa j karan kaaran samarath ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are struck down by the All-powerful, the Cause of causes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee 5 ||
lines.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਫਾਹੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਤੁਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: lai phaahe raatee turahi prabh jaanai praanee ||
lines.translation: They take the noose in their hands, and go out at night to strangle others, but God knows everything, O mortal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਕਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਈਆ ਲੁਕਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਠਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: takahi naar paraaeeaa luk a(n)dar thaanee ||
lines.translation: They spy on other men's women, concealed in their hiding places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਨੑੀ ਦੇਨੑਿ ਵਿਖੰਮ ਥਾਇ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਦੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)nhee denhi vikha(n)m thaai mithaa mad maanee ||
lines.translation: They break into well-protected places, and revel in sweet wine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karamee aapo aapanee aape pachhutaanee ||
lines.translation: But they shall come to regret their actions - they create their own karma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀ ॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: ajaraaeel pharesataa til peeRe ghaanee ||27||
lines.translation: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall crush them like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕੇ ਸੇਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak sache saah ke seee paravaan ||
lines.translation: The servants of the True King are acceptable and approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੇ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: doojaa sevan naanakaa se pach pach mue ajaan ||1||
lines.translation: Those ignorant ones who serve duality, O Nanak, rot, waste away and die. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa lekh prabh metanaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: That destiny which was pre-ordained by God from the very beginning cannot be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam dhan vakharo naanak sadaa dhiaai ||2||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Name is Nanak's capital; he meditates on it forever. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee 5 ||
lines.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਨਾਠੂੰਗੜਾ ਪੈਰ ਕਿਥੈ ਰਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naaraain laiaa naathoo(n)gaRaa pair kithai rakhai ||
lines.translation: One who has received a kick from the Lord God - where can he place his foot?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਦਾ ਪਾਪ ਅਮਿਤਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਵਿਸੋ ਚਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karadaa paap amitiaa nit viso chakhai ||
lines.translation: He commits countless sins, and continually eats poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa karadaa pach muaa vich dehee bhakhai ||
lines.translation: Slandering others, he wastes away and dies; within his body, he burns.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai saahib maariaa kaun tis no rakhai ||
lines.translation: One who has been struck down by the True Lord and Master - who can save him now?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲਖੈ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee jo purakh alakhai ||28||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Unseen Lord, the Primal Being. ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: narak ghor bahu dukh ghane akirataghanaa kaa thaan ||
lines.translation: In the most horrible hell, there is terrible pain and suffering. It is the place of the ungrateful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਏ ਹਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tin prabh maare naanakaa hoi hoi mue haraam ||1||
lines.translation: They are struck down by God, O Nanak, and they die a most miserable death. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਖਧ ਸਭੇ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: avakhadh sabhe keetian ni(n)dak kaa daaroo naahi ||
lines.translation: All kinds of medicines may be prepared, but there is no cure for the slanderer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaae naanakaa pach pach jonee paahi ||2||
lines.translation: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads, O Nanak, putrefy and rot in reincarnation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee 5 ||
lines.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tus ditaa poorai satiguroo har dhan sach akhut ||
lines.translation: By His Pleasure, the True Guru has blessed me with the inexhaustible wealth of the Name of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੁਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh a(n)dese mit gae jam kaa bhau chhut ||
lines.translation: All my anxiety is ended; I am rid of the fear of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤੁਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh buriaaeeaa(n) sa(n)g saadhoo tut ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger and other evils have been subdued in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਹੁਇ ਮਰਸਨਿ ਬੁਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin sache doojaa sevade hui marasan but ||
lines.translation: Those who serve another, instead of the True Lord, die unfulfilled in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਟੁ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau gur bakhasiaa naamai sa(n)g jut ||29||
lines.translation: The Guru has blessed Nanak with forgiveness; he is united with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਪਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਦ੍ਰਹੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਨਿਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਜਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tapaa na hovai a(n)drahu lobhee nit maaiaa no phirai jajamaaliaa ||
lines.translation: He is not a penitent, who is greedy within his heart, and who constantly chases after Maya like a leper.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਸਦਿਆ ਸਤੈ ਦੀ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਲਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਣਿ ਤਪੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ago de sadiaa satai dee bhikhiaa lae naahee pichho de pachhutaai kai aan tapai put vich bahaaliaa ||
lines.translation: When this penitent was first invited, he refused our charity; but later he repented and sent his son, who was seated in the congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਲੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਹਸਣ ਲਗੇ ਤਪਾ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch log sabh hasan lage tapaa lobh lahar hai gaaliaa ||
lines.translation: The village elders all laughed, saying that the waves of greed have destroyed this penitent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਥੋੜਾ ਧਨੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਤਪਾ ਭਿਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਧਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਪੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai thoRaa dhan vekhai tithai tapaa bhitai naahee dhan bahutai dithai tapai dharam haariaa ||
lines.translation: If he sees only a little wealth, he does not bother to go there; but when he sees a lot of wealth, the penitent forsakes his vows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee ehu tapaa na hovee bagulaa hai bahi saadh janaa veechaariaa ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, he is not a penitent - he is only a stork. Sitting together, the Holy Congregation has so decided.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਤਪਾ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਏਤੁ ਦੋਖੈ ਤਪਾ ਦਯਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat purakh kee tapaa ni(n)daa karai sa(n)saarai kee usatatee vich hovai et dokhai tapaa day maariaa ||
lines.translation: The penitent slanders the True Primal Being, and sings the praises of the material world. For this sin, he is cursed by the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਜਿ ਤਪੇ ਨੋ ਫਲੁ ਲਗਾ ਸਭੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਪੇ ਕਾ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa purakhaa(n) kee ni(n)daa kaa vekh j tape no phal lagaa sabh gaiaa tape kaa ghaaliaa ||
lines.translation: Behold the fruit the penitent gathers, for slandering the Great Primal Being; all his labors have gone in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਪੰਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਪਾ ਸਦਾਏ ॥ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਪਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਨੋ ਉਘਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar bahai pa(n)chaa vich tapaa sadaae || a(n)dar bahai tapaa paap kamaae || har a(n)daralaa paap pa(n)chaa no ughaa kar vekhaaliaa ||
lines.translation: When he sits outside among the elders, he is called a penitent; But when he sits within the congregation, the penitent commits sin. The Lord has exposed the penitent's secret sin to the elders.
